summary: Tenet Healthcare filed an 8-K on September 8, 2026, disclosing a $1.5B private placement launch and the upsize/pricing of $2.0B 6.250% senior unsecured notes due 2034, expected to close September 22, 2026. Proceeds, plus cash, will redeem all $1.5B of 5.125% senior secured first lien notes due 2027 and partially redeem $0.5B of 6.125% senior notes due 2028, with redemption set for September 23, 2026. The notes rank equal with senior unsecured debt and structurally junior to subsidiary liabilities. Watch execution and conditional redemption satisfaction.
